newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank shares stable in Tokyo afternoon.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank shares stable in Tokyo afternoon.

text.p: Shares in Asahi Bank were stable on Thursday afternoon despite media reports that its New York branch could face legal action for reportedly looking at a confidential Federal Reserve inspection report, brokers said.
At 0430 GMT the shares were up 30 yen at 1,180 yen.
Kyodo news agency said earlier that the Fed considered the act malicious and was considering taking legal action against Asahi for disrupting its inspection activities.
The agency also quoted Asahi Bank's president Shigehiko Yoshino as saying in an interview that the branch had not incurred any huge losses.
"There is absolutely no case where we incurred large losses," Yoshino said in response to rumours that Asahi Bank's New York branch had incurred huge losses.
Yoshino also acknowledged that bank employees opened the Federal Reserve's sealed inspection report on Asahi and said he realised it might face penalities in consequence.
